# Data dictionary

> Generated by `npm run data-dictionary` ([`scripts/gen-data-dictionary.js`](https://github.com/DEFRA/bng-metric-backend/blob/main/scripts/gen-data-dictionary.js)).
> Do not edit by hand — change the Drizzle schema or the Joi `.description()`
> annotations and regenerate. See [`docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md`](https://github.com/DEFRA/bng-metric-backend/blob/main/docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md) for
> the workflow and the CI freshness check.

## Postgres tables

### `bng.audit_log`

A full snapshot of a project after every change, recording who made it and when, for audit history.

| Column                | Type                       | Nullable | Key | Default             |
| --------------------- | -------------------------- | -------- | --- | ------------------- |
| `id`                  | `uuid`                     | —        | PK  | `gen_random_uuid()` |
| `project_id`          | `uuid`                     | —        | —   | —                   |
| `project`             | `jsonb`                    | —        | —   | —                   |
| `previous_project`    | `jsonb`                    | ✓        | —   | —                   |
| `user_id`             | `text`                     | —        | —   | —                   |
| `bng_project_version` | `integer`                  | —        | —   | —                   |
| `operation`           | `text`                     | —        | —   | —                   |
| `audited_at`          | `timestamp with time zone` | —        | —   | `now()`             |

### `bng.login_audit`

An append-only record of every successful user login, capturing the user identity, current relationship and session from the verified token, with a UTC timestamp.

| Column                    | Type                       | Nullable | Key | Default             |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------- | -------- | --- | ------------------- |
| `id`                      | `uuid`                     | —        | PK  | `gen_random_uuid()` |
| `user_id`                 | `text`                     | —        | —   | —                   |
| `email`                   | `text`                     | ✓        | —   | —                   |
| `first_name`              | `text`                     | ✓        | —   | —                   |
| `last_name`               | `text`                     | ✓        | —   | —                   |
| `current_relationship_id` | `text`                     | ✓        | —   | —                   |
| `session_id`              | `text`                     | ✓        | —   | —                   |
| `logged_in_at`            | `timestamp with time zone` | —        | —   | `now()`             |

UNIQUE (`session_id`, `current_relationship_id`) — `uq_login_audit_session_relationship`.

UNIQUE INDEX `uq_login_audit_session_no_relationship` (`session_id`) WHERE `"bng"."login_audit"."current_relationship_id" is null`.

### `bng.relationships`

The organisations a user is related to, taken from their Defra ID token and upserted on each login (one row per user's relationship).

| Column            | Type                       | Nullable | Key                  | Default |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | -------- | -------------------- | ------- |
| `user_id`         | `text`                     | —        | FK → `users.user_id` | —       |
| `relationship_id` | `text`                     | —        | —                    | —       |
| `org_id`          | `text`                     | ✓        | —                    | —       |
| `org_name`        | `text`                     | ✓        | —                    | —       |
| `relationship`    | `text`                     | ✓        | —                    | —       |
| `last_updated`    | `timestamp with time zone` | —        | —                    | `now()` |

UNIQUE (`user_id`, `relationship_id`) — `uq_relationships_user_rel`.

### `bng.roles`

The roles and their approval status a user holds per organisation relationship, upserted from the Defra ID token on each login; drives project access control.

| Column            | Type                       | Nullable | Key                  | Default |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | -------- | -------------------- | ------- |
| `user_id`         | `text`                     | —        | FK → `users.user_id` | —       |
| `relationship_id` | `text`                     | —        | —                    | —       |
| `name`            | `text`                     | —        | —                    | —       |
| `status`          | `smallint`                 | —        | —                    | —       |
| `last_updated`    | `timestamp with time zone` | —        | —                    | `now()` |

UNIQUE (`user_id`, `relationship_id`, `name`) — `uq_roles_user_rel_name`.

## The `project` JSONB document

Stored in `bng.projects.project` and snapshotted verbatim into
`bng.audit_log.project`. Fields below are derived from the Joi schema in
[`src/validation/project.js`](https://github.com/DEFRA/bng-metric-backend/blob/main/src/validation/project.js).

While the service-template flag lets either template be uploaded, **Template**
says which uploads fill each field: **BNG Service** (the new template),
**Legacy** (the Natural England template, whose fields go in BMD-1097), or
**Both**. A field the other template does not fill is absent or empty in its
documents. **Neither** marks a legacy field of a feature only the BNG Service
template has: it is always empty. Set in [`src/validation/template-applicability.js`](https://github.com/DEFRA/bng-metric-backend/blob/main/src/validation/template-applicability.js).

| Field                                                                             | Type            | Template               | Constraints                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

editable via PATCH /projects/{id} and, with the other details, PATCH /projects/{id}/details.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

Only a Created or Enhanced habitat raises any: FLAG1-FLAG6 and FLAG9 from its timing against the standard time to target and time to Poor condition, FLAG7 for a "Fairly" condition, FLAG8 on an Enhanced habitat whose broad habitat differs from its baseline's, and FLAG10 on a Created watercourse footprint. Derived from the stored fields whenever the habitat is priced, at import and on edit; they never change units or refuse a file. On a project saved before BMD-822 the field is absent until it is next written: re-uploading a file writes it on every habitat of that document, editing a habitat writes it on that habitat, and editing a baseline habitat writes it on every post-intervention habitat. Such a project can therefore hold the field on some habitats and not others. Absent means the flags have not been worked out yet, not that none apply. |

| `postIntervention.tradingRules.areaHabitats.low.cumulativeAvailability`           | `number`        | Both                   | —                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Units available to the Low band once the Medium surplus is carried down: the Medium surplus plus the Low net change. Deliberately NOT the Statutory Metric's "Cumulative surplus of units", which cancels the Medium deficit against the Medium surplus first and so is always lower by the size of that deficit — 23.1012 against 32.5222 on the worked example. The trading rules do not permit that cancellation: a surplus in one broad habitat cannot make good a deficit in another. This figure is therefore not safe to judge compliance on alone; the Medium band has to be accounted for in its own right.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

## Notes

- **`*.properties` open maps** hold the raw attribute columns copied
  verbatim from the uploaded GeoPackage. Their column catalogue is defined
  separately in [`src/validation/reference/gpkg-template.schema.json`](https://github.com/DEFRA/bng-metric-backend/blob/main/src/validation/reference/gpkg-template.schema.json); the case-insensitive
  key resolution lives in [`src/validation/geopackage/properties.js`](https://github.com/DEFRA/bng-metric-backend/blob/main/src/validation/geopackage/properties.js). A BNG Service
  template document keys them by that template's column names (a
  reference is `Habitat Ref`); a legacy document by the legacy template's
  (`Parcel Ref`, `Tree Ref`). A BNG Service template document saved before
  BMD-1085 may still use the legacy names, until its file is uploaded again.
- **Derived unit fields** (`distinctiveness`, `distinctivenessScore`,
  `conditionScore`, `units`) are set on habitats, hedgerows and watercourses
  by bng-library/metric — during baseline import enrichment and again when a
  feature is edited. `units` is the single field read by the frontend display
  and the baseline unit totals. Watercourses additionally carry
  `waterEncroachmentMultiplier` / `riparianEncroachmentMultiplier`.
- **Enum values** for habitat type, broad type, condition, distinctiveness
  etc. are not enumerated in the Joi schema; they are resolved at runtime
  from `bng-library/metric` via `src/validation/reference/*`.
